iut_type: New Receipt Number 6-month unused-expiration policy (effective September 9, 2025) -- scoped to 'unused' meaning not yet applied to a server Submission, not tied to Compliance Folder completion status
customer_question: Bluetooth SIG announced that, alongside a fee revision, 'Receipt Numbers issued to Adopter members on or after September 9, 2025 will expire if left unused 6 months after the payment date.' We haven't finished our Compliance Folder yet -- does this expiration deadline apply to us?
question_variants: What does 'unused' mean in the context of this new Receipt Number expiration policy?
Does completing the Compliance Folder count as part of 'using' a Receipt Number?
actual_issue: The customer saw SIG's announcement of a new policy under which Receipt Numbers issued to Adopter members from September 9, 2025 onward would expire after 6 months if left unused, and -- since their own Compliance Folder paperwork was still incomplete -- wanted to confirm whether this expiration risk applied to their already-registered product.
plain_english_explanation: The new policy's 6-month unused-expiration clock applies specifically to Receipt Numbers that have not yet been applied to a completed server registration (Submission) -- it is not tied to whether the Compliance Folder has been assembled or submitted. In this customer's case, the registration to the server had already been completed and the listing was already publicly visible well before the Compliance Folder paperwork was finished -- meaning the Receipt Number had already been 'used' at the moment registration was completed (Submission), regardless of how much time it then takes to finish the separate, subsequent Compliance Folder documentation process. Since the Receipt Number was already used at registration completion, the 6-month unused-expiration condition simply does not apply -- that clock only matters for a Receipt Number that has been obtained (via Invoice payment) but never actually applied to a completed registration Submission within 6 months.
consultant_answer: No, this doesn't affect you -- your registration to the server is already complete and publicly listed, which means your Receipt Number was already considered 'used' at that point. The 6-month unused-expiration policy only applies to Receipt Numbers that haven't yet been applied to a completed registration Submission -- it has nothing to do with whether your Compliance Folder paperwork is finished, since that's a separate, later step.
decision_logic: When a customer asks whether the new Receipt Number 6-month unused-expiration policy affects their pending registration, check whether the registration's server Submission has already been completed -- if so, the Receipt Number is already 'used' regardless of Compliance Folder completion status, and the expiration policy does not apply; the policy only matters for Receipt Numbers obtained but never yet applied to a completed Submission.
final_recommendation: When explaining the new Receipt Number expiration policy to customers, clarify upfront that 'unused' specifically means 'not yet applied to a completed registration Submission,' distinct from and unrelated to Compliance Folder completion status, to prevent unnecessary concern from customers with pending post-registration paperwork.
risk_if_done_wrong: A customer might mistakenly believe an already-completed registration is at risk of Receipt Number expiration due to a slow Compliance Folder process, causing unnecessary alarm or rushed documentation.
